# Reference farm regression fixtures

These three synthetic but structurally valid farms are used only to capture and compare legacy behavior during the COCOAID v3 migration. They are not real farmer records and contain no personal identifiers.

- `small_low_risk.json`: small, generally healthy farm.
- `medium_baseline.json`: medium farm close to the v2.11 defaults.
- `large_high_risk.json`: larger farm with poor drainage, nutrient constraints, aging palms, and multiple reported symptoms.
